steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *sigh*...

options: Mulberry, your thoughts as her guide?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: D-Doctor, I think, given how straightforward Blacknight always is, she must've left right after handing in the form.

options: You sound disgruntled about her.
So you let her leave?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Mm... but my opinion doesn't matter much, Doctor. What do you think?

spans.text: Mm... but my opinion doesn't matter much, Doctor. What do

options: If she's gone, there's nothing more to discuss.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Something tells me you're not too happy with this yourself...

options: You're overthinking it.
*cough* I appreciate your concern.
Do you know why she decided to leave?
Still, I'm curious what her reasons were.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I-I'm not sure myself.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *sigh*... I thought she'd gotten used to life here. Though she did seem uncomfortable when we first met.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Her condition wasn't too stable at that point, so Medical suggested she remain aboard as an official operator so they could check up on her at any time, which she agreed to.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: That's when they assigned me as her guide, to get her used to the ins and outs of the landship...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So... you're my captain here? You think you can protect me with those stubby limbs of yours?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: B-Blacknight, I may not be a match for you physically, but if we ever run into danger, I'll do everything I can to keep you safe.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Heh, someone's confident. Good show.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...Am I gonna be living with you in this room then?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Your condition isn't bad enough to require admission to Medical, but we still can't leave you unobserved yet.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: So I'll be living with you to make it more convenient to give you check-ups.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Man, can't we open some windows in here? I need some breeze.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Is it too stuffy for you? I can turn on the air conditioner.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: How's that?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hmm... a little ehh, if you ask me.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Are you feeling uncomfortable?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I guess? Probably down to my health.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Sorry, um, excuse me.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hey, what're you up to?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Your forehead temperature feels normal...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: We can visit Medical after dinner, and carry out a detailed examination.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Er... why exactly? I'm basically fine.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Are you sure? You still seem uneasy.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: 'Course I'm sure.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: A-Alright then...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Oh, I almost forgot to give you this.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: And... what is it?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Talismans.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I can see that. Little too many for one string though, yeah?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Well... I was thinking the more I add, the more effective it'll be.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Look, I'm gonna be upfront—I wouldn't be caught dead carrying that mess everywhere I go.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You don't need to take it with you, you can just hang it in your wardrobe.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Pass. Reeks of incense. It'll get on my clothes too.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I-I'm sorry, I didn't even consider that!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Tch... That's the thing with pampered little princesses like you. Such a pain to deal with.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Oh dear, she's so hard to get along with... No, whatever else, this is my mission. I need to make sure I'm on good terms with her.)

spans.text: (Oh dear, she's so hard to get along with... No, whatever else, this is my mission. I
to make sure I'm on good terms with her.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: So... is there anywhere you'd like to see? I can show you around?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Don't bother. And don't follow me either.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: 'But' my arse.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Blacknight, wait!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: For the longest time, I thought she was just a loner by nature. And coupled with being fresh aboard, it made sense she was cautious.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...But now I realize, she simply didn't like it here.

options: But she didn't leave straight away.
Still, why only choose to leave now?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: There was one time last month, when we wrapped up a field support mission and came back from the wilds. Not long after, she gave me her application to resign from formal operator status and return to being a cooperative contractor.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I think what happened out there might've made her dissatisfied with us.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Or maybe... I was the problem. Maybe I'm the reason she couldn't stand being here.

options: Cool it. That's nonsense.
Trust me, she wouldn't think like that.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor...

options: So what went down out there anyway?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I've been wondering that myself, honestly. As far as I could tell, it wasn't particularly distressing. I found it all very fascinating, actually, even pleasant.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I thought we'd grown quite a bit closer, too, after that mission.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I even felt like she was finally fitting in here.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: First things first. Follow my directions while we're out there, and don't drag me down.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: But—I'm the captain?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Could you beat me in a fight?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Have you lived in the barrens longer than I have?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So why should I listen to your orders?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...Pfft. Hahahaha.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Wha— What's so funny, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Nothing, just thought it was hilarious watching your brain lock up in real time like that.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: So when you said...?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Just pulling your leg. Mission's almost over as is and you're still all wound up, stuck inside a tent all day. Had to yank you out for a walk.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Oh. And here I thought...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Thought I was speaking my mind there?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Tell you the truth, it would've been, not too long ago.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...So I wasn't just imagining things.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: But I was being unfair, wasn't I? We've been around each other plenty now, and every little thing you do's proven just how amazing you really are.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I-I'm very flattered, but for you to suddenly start praising me like this...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Why so awkward? You earned a thumb's up, so you get one. I still remember that old woman we'd all written off, but you found a way to save her against all odds.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I couldn't have done it without everyone's help.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Stop quibbling and take the compliment. I'm calling you amazing because you are. Don't you doubt that.

spans.text: Stop quibbling and take the compliment. I'm calling you amazing because you

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Here, catch. Give it a try.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: The hell? How'd you miss a pass from that close?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Whatever, you can have the other one.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: D-Don't pick it back up! You shouldn't eat fruit off the ground, it's unsanitary! You'll ruin your stomach.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Stuff that, it's just a bit of broken skin. Still good.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: At least wipe it off with your sleeve.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...Th-This is amazing. I've never had fruit like this before.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Once, me and my mates were taking a route that passed through a forest by a river.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: The trees were full of fruit like this. Each of us left with a giant heap we'd picked, all crammed into our bags.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Never came across any again after that. Surprised there's so many growing around here.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: We can pick a few more to take back, to let everyone try some.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I didn't drag you out today to go fruit-picking.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Oh, I-I didn't realize... Was there something else, then? I thought we were just outside for a walk.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: What're you sweating buckets for? Follow me.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Ah—don't—don't pull me!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Where are...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Shh, quiet. There's a massive bugger tucked inside this cave. Don't scare her.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Why did you take me here? This is so dangerous.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Dangerous? You're safe as houses with me, okay?)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (My professor used to say we should steer clear of wild animals as much as we can while working in the field.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Shut it. Who cares what your professor said? Watch carefully. It's coming out.)
Subtle stirrings emanate from the cave. Mulberry squints, trying to catch a closer look.
But after a long while, the stirrings abate, leaving the bushes in front of the opening to rustle in the wind, swaying and shuffling as they do.
Just as she's about to lose patience and tell her companion that they should head back to camp, a wild beast emerges from the cave without fanfare.
Its flesh is rugged, its hide sleek, and with a yawn it bares its coarse tusks for all to see, easily capable of mauling the throats of its prey.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (That—That's a big one...)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (I-I'm getting scared now, Blacknight, we—we should... head back.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Relax, she won't notice us from this distance. Besides, getting up now would just draw her attention here.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (B-But I...)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Hold tight, just a little longer.)

The sheer fearsomeness of the beast makes Mulberry involuntarily bury her face halfway into her arms, leaving only a pair of eyes peeking out, furtively taking in the sight of it sniffing about its cave's entrance.
Seemingly assured no danger lurks nearby, it settles down and lets out a rumbling howl, as if calling for something.
Sure enough, a beastling soon waddles out from the cave, its gait unsteady.
After just a few steps, it tumbles heavily—perhaps the mud is too slick—and knocks its head on the senior beast's hind legs.
The beast isn't the least bit perturbed, simply craning its head around and lapping at the beastling's head, encouraging it to get up again.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Go on. You can do it, little one.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Wow, wooow, he did it!)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (He—He's so cute.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (I was looking for food around here a while back and found her pregnant. By my count, I figured the baby'd be born by now.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (That's so sweet. He'll have nothing to fear with his mom by his side.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Look. They're about to go.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Go where?)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (They need to stuff themselves while it's still autumn, so they can make it through the freezing winter okay.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Alright, enough gawking, they're out of sight now. About time we headed back too.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I've never seen anything like that before, never ever. Oh, no, I did see a documentary once, but it's not like that counts.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I've never seen something so stunning with my own eyes.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Stunning? It's the most normal thing there is.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You must've seen sights this wonderful all the time where you used to live. Otherwise you wouldn't say that.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...You're right. Saw it all over.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Remember to write it down.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Eh? Write what down?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Remember to put it in the report we're sending back to the landship. It's a very special kind of experience. It deserves a mention.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...Got it. Will do.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: And don't put it off until the very last day, either.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Alright, alright, get a move on. Let's go pick the rest of those fruits. Bet everyone at camp'll want to try some.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I think that must be what angered her. It's my fault for not reading the room, for spoiling the mood like that. I'm sure all the paperwork and regulations go completely against her style.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *sigh* What now, Doctor? Blacknight's already gone, and I only realized after the fact. I didn't even get the chance to apologize.

options: Don't worry, it's not your fault.
Don't regret not saying sorry. Regret not saying goodbye.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Regardless, it's too late now.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: What're you two muttering about in here? Hey, Doctor, has my application gone through? It's been days already. Why haven't I heard a peep?

options: We're in the middle of discussing it.
You should've knocked first.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hmph. You act like you're my nan.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Blacknight, oh... I thought you'd left, I-I was wondering how I never even got to say goodbye...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: What? Don't you lot have a rule about submitting a report and waiting for approval before leaving?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...Um, I thought you were fed up with all the rules?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Eh, I've spent enough time here to work out why you have 'em. I don't like them, but I can adapt.

spans.text: Eh, I've spent enough time here to work out why you have 'em. I don't

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Besides... I've got friends here. Can't just vanish without a word.

options: At least tell us why you're leaving.
Why aren't you a fan of this place?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: That's right! If there's anything bothering you, you're absolutely free to mention it, and we'll help you sort it out.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: It's not the place, that's not the issue.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: If not the place, then... the people here? Y-You don't want to stay because you're s-sick of me, aren't you...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Never even crossed my mind.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You don't hate me?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: You kidding? You're amazing. Responsible, professional, you name it. Would've left ages ago if you didn't need my help.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I did?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Yeah. You remember that day, right?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, Blacknight. What brings you here? Are you feeling unwell?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: No, sorry, 'scuse me. Is Mulberry in?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She is. Are you... waiting for her?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I heard she finished her mission and came back yesterday, but I still haven't seen her yet. Something wrong? She hurt?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, not at all.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So what's she been up to?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We brought back more patients than expected for this rescue mission. Medical's been all hands on deck, so we've temporarily transferred Mulberry here for urgent treatment of our less critical patients.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: How's that fair? She just got back from a field mission.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She insisted. She was originally meant to be coming back the next day, anyway.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Whoof...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: So you're worried about her?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Why do you look so surprised about that?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No, it's just that she's always so gloomy whenever she brings you up. She seems to think you don't like being around her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hey, I never said that.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: That's good, then. We're all hoping you'll be able to help her out more.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Help her out? With what?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You can totally trust her on the professional front, but she's still young, and doesn't have much experience with wasteland survival. But now that she has you, you can teach her as you go.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So is she done with work right now?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: She should've been done forever ago...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... sir, you're wounded... please stay still...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, gosh. She's just fallen asleep up against the clothes locker. The exhaustion must've gotten to her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: What's she nattering about? She can't even sleep easy...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Helmet.

steps.name: Helmet
steps.text: Mreep!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Put her under properly.

steps.name: Helmet
steps.text: Shrrp—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Lets out a long, slow breath.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Say, mind if I lend a hand here? I'll carry her on my back. Won't do her any good sleeping here.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, uhh, okay.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Seriously, you give me nothing but trouble.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: So you're the one who brought me back to the dorms that day.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Who else? It's thanks to Helmet you slept so sound that night, y'know.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I had it all wrong...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: You just love overthinking things.

options: I bet it took more than just overthinking.
It's your fault too, for not being clearer.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Sorry, I'd never gotten to know any girls like you before.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Didn't mean to make you worry.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It's okay, we—we sorted out the misunderstanding, so, um, please stay! I've learned so much here, and I'm sure I can help you keep your illness under control.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Thing is, I just... wanna go back to the barrens. Life out there suits me better.

options: No problem. There's always more fieldwork.
You can specialize in barrenlands field missions.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Nah, it's just not the same. I know, I know, I don't have to worry about the basics here, and I can get drugs for my sickness. I've made new friends, learned new tricks, the whole shebang.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Ought to know a good thing when I see it...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: But sometimes, I wake up at night, and I stare at the ceiling and it's all white. No moons, no stars, no chirping, and I just feel hollow inside.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: My instincts are shouting it, my heart's screaming it, and my thinker's torturing me over it.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: It's just the simplest thing—

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I need to live somewhere I can see the sky when I look up.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Do you... Do you know just how bad your health is, Blacknight? How will the sky do anything to protect you?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I don't agree to this! I do not approve your application! Doctor, please don't approve her application!

spans.text: I don't agree to this! I do
approve your application! Doctor, please don't approve her application!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Listen to me, Mulberry. I know I'm skint for choices. That's why I'm choosing what I want most, honest.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Remember that beast I took you to see?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Mm... It's never left my mind.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Out in the barrens, there's plenty more like her. Loads and loads.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Few years back, I came across a slumberfoot. She was a tough little cub. The moment I saw her, I decided I wanted to tame her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: But I tried a few times to get close and communicate with her, and she kept refusing. Whenever she saw me, she just scurried straight away. Tasty food, a soft bed, nothing could make her care.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Then one time, by accident, she got hurt by her own prey. I saved her, took her back to camp, and treated her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: As she healed up, gradually, that tension she had around me gave way to a new familiarity.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Thought I'd managed to tame her, so I stopped keeping an eye on her round the clock.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: But after a short hunting trip, I came back to camp and she was gone. Left nothing but the little cap I knitted her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I was furious. Imagine how hard it is to even get a hold of yarn in the barrens... I thought she loved that cap.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So I followed her tracks. Went after her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: And when I found her, she was rolling about in the dunes, absolutely grimy. But she was happy as could be, the happiest I'd ever seen her.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So I just turned around and left. In that instant, I learned. She didn't belong to me. She belonged to those dunes, to that huge old desert.

options: ...Alright.
I understand.
Blacknight, I approve your application to depart.
You are once again an RI collaborative operator. You can go.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: If you have to leave... then—then at least, remember to bring enough medicine before you go.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Come on. Come on, connect.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Hello? Is anyone listening? This is Operator Mulberry! I've encountered an exceptionally bad sandstorm en route to a mission in Lungmen! Requesting urgent support!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Hello? Is anyone there?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Is this really it? This can't be... No...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (I'm going to die here.)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I feel so hungry. So tired. So terrible.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Nobody's coming, are they...? There's nobody to come.

spans.text: Nobody's coming, are they...? There's nobody

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *whimper*... Mom... Dad...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I'm sorry... I can't... hold on any longer...
Mreep—mreep—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Who... Who's that licking me? Uwgh, that tickles...)
If you're awake, hurry up and open your eyes.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (I can't see properly. That voice sounds so familiar...)
What're you doing just squinting there?
Oh, you got sand in your eyes.
(Blows)
Give me a blink. That any better?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Strewth, what would you do without me?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Waah—

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hey, hey, what're you hugging me so hard for?!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Come on, let go!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...I missed you so, so much.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Alright, alright... fine, just a little. I'll let you hug me just a little longer.
